title: AUTOMERGE | AUTOS* | AUTOCHESTS | AUTOTOWERS
features:
🤖 Auto Units — Automatically summons new units whenever you have enough coins.

⬆️ Auto Level — Upgrades your Spawn Level automatically to spawn stronger units.

🧩 Auto Merge — Smartly merges identical units on the board and optimizes your combat slots.

🛍️ Auto Shop — Automatically purchases selected Chests and Towers from the Stock Shop as soon as they restock.

💰 Smart Coin Reserve — Holds onto enough coins for high-priority Shop items so Auto-Units won't accidentally drain your balance.

⚙️ Customizable Delay — Adjust action speed/intervals (down to 0.01s) to match your executor and connection.
